paper.title: Recurrent Neural Network Wave Functions
paper.authors: Mohamed Hibat-Allah, Martin Ganahl, Lauren E. Hayward, Roger G. Melko, Juan Carrasquilla

results.system_description: Two-dimensional transverse-field Ising model, Eq. (14), H = -sum sigma^z_i sigma^z_j - h sum sigma^x_i with Pauli matrices, 12 x 12 square lattice, open boundaries, h = 3
results.variant: positive 2D vanilla RNN, one layer, 100 memory units
results.source_location: Appendix F, Table II, row h = 3, column 2DRNN (bold); also Fig. 5(c)
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per site of the two-dimensional recurrent neural network wave function, estimated with 2 x 10^6 samples (Table II caption); the table lists DMRG separately.
results.notes: Energy per site as printed; the Hamiltonian is this instance's. The meaning of the parenthesized error is not stated. The table's DMRG value is -3.17389966, slightly above this energy. Varbench lists the same energy (TFIsing/square_144_O_3, -457.041866(27)).
